teams.heading: Jack Crowley ruled out of Ireland duty until the new year
teams.body: Ireland fly-half Jack Crowley will remain sidelined until the new year as he continues his recovery from a lower limb vascular injury. The 26-year-old has been out of action since April and will miss the upcoming autumn block against Argentina, Fiji and South Africa. Munster head coach Clayton McMillan emphasised the cautious approach to his rehabilitation, stating, "Jack Crowley is a very important player for Munster and Ireland with a big future in the game and ensuring he gets back to 100% is the priority."

teams.heading: Japan Rugby League One settles legal dispute over player eligibility rules
teams.body: Japan Rugby League One has revised its controversial player registration system following a legal challenge from 25 players, including international stars like Timothy Lafaele and Lomano Lemeki. The league will now classify naturalised players alongside Japan-born counterparts, provided they held citizenship by May 2025. Additionally, players with 30 or more Brave Blossoms caps are reclassified from the restricted Category A-2 to A-1. The JRLO admitted that prior communication regarding the implementation of these registration changes had been insufficient.

lead.why: The JRLO's settlement of the high-profile legal dispute regarding player eligibility rules marks a major structural shift for the domestic game.

teams.heading: South Africa overcome New Zealand to level the four-test series
teams.body: The Springboks secured a hard-fought 33-26 victory over New Zealand in Cape Town on Saturday, successfully levelling the series at 1-1. Despite the All Blacks outscoring the hosts by four tries to three, South Africa’s clinical edge proved decisive. Cheslin Kolbe, who overcame an injury scare to start, delivered a player-of-the-match performance by contributing 18 points from the tee. Late in the game, Cameron Hanekom’s crucial turnover stifled a final New Zealand assault, keeping the hosts' series ambitions alive.

lead.why: The result levels the high-profile series and shifts momentum ahead of the third test.
